target: positive ALLN (model eLN), positive presynaptic sources only; every ORN and unselected source and every non-eLN target preserved
peak_definition: maximum rolling average; window wholly inside each 1s ON; 1ms steps

threshold_provenance.peak_fraction: user: peak at least 70% of paired baseline; apply to both widths and both pulses
threshold_provenance.late_fraction: provisional operational choice before runs; user said not extremely suppressed
threshold_provenance.quiet_hz: provisional operational choice before runs for OFF1s, OFF20s and second OFF1s; user said few Hz at OFF20s

recovery_criterion: second peak >=70% of same-seed baseline second peak at both widths AND second peak50 > first OFF20s; quiet OFF20s checked separately
candidate_criterion: all seven component checks (including ON late) pass in every one of four trials; baseline is reference, never adopted as STD
unchanged: refractory handling, adaptation disabled, first spike amplitude, no OFF-triggered reset, 50ms endTick
parameters: engineering probe, not physiological calibration; tau=resource recovery time, not a fixed 300ms suppression window
